text: Caramel is set in the mould first (about 5 min), the custard poured on top, and the mould covered and steamed until just set. The egg proteins set gently in the steam, so the flan stays smooth; the caramel ends up on top when it is unmoulded. Quantities from one Filipino recipe site (6 servings).
